changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'NOT_NULL', '非空检查', 'COMPLETENESS', '检查指定列是否存在空值或空字符串', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, {{column}} AS actual_value, ''字段不能为空'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE {{column}} IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) = ''''', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'ENUM_CHECK', '值域枚举', 'ACCURACY', '检查字段值是否在允许的枚举范围内', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"allowed_values","label":"允许值(逗号分隔)","type":"text","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, {{column}} AS actual_value, ''值不在允许范围内'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE {{column}} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) != '''' AND {{column}} NOT IN ({{allowed_values:csv}})', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'DATE_FORMAT', '日期格式检查', 'CONSISTENCY', '检查日期字段是否符合指定的格式模式', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"pattern","label":"日期正则(默认YYYY-MM-DD)","type":"text","required":false,"default":"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, {{column}} AS actual_value, ''日期格式不符合要求'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE {{column}} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) != '''' AND CAST({{column}} AS text) !~ ''{{pattern}}''', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'NUMERIC_RANGE', '数值范围', 'ACCURACY', '检查数值字段是否在指定的最小值和最大值范围内', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"min","label":"最小值","type":"number","required":true},{"name":"max","label":"最大值","type":"number","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, {{column}} AS actual_value, ''数值超出范围 [{{min}}, {{max}}]'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE {{column}} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) != '''' AND (CAST({{column}} AS text) !~ ''^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'' OR CAST({{column}} AS numeric) NOT BETWEEN {{min}} AND {{max}})', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'UNIQUE_CHECK', '唯一性检查', 'UNIQUENESS', '检查指定列是否存在重复值（简化版，单列适用；多列版后续优化）', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"columns","label":"检查列(逗号分隔)","type":"text","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT t.id, ''{{columns}}'' AS fail_column, {{columns}} AS actual_value, ''存在重复值'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} t INNER JOIN (SELECT {{columns}} FROM {{table}} GROUP BY {{columns}} HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) dup ON t.{{columns}} = dup.{{columns}}', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'CROSS_COLUMN', '跨列逻辑', 'CONSISTENCY', '检查跨列条件表达式是否成立', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"expression","label":"条件表达式","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"description","label":"规则描述","type":"text","required":false}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, '''' AS fail_column, '''' AS actual_value, ''{{description}}'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE NOT ({{expression}})', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'CROSS_TABLE_REF', '跨表引用', 'CONSISTENCY', '检查字段值是否在引用表的对应列中存在', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"ref_table","label":"引用表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"ref_column","label":"引用列","type":"text","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT t.id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, t.{{column}} AS actual_value, ''引用值在 {{ref_table}}.{{ref_column}} 中不存在'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} t LEFT JOIN {{ref_table}} r ON CAST(t.{{column}} AS text) = CAST(r.{{ref_column}} AS text) WHERE t.{{column}} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(t.{{column}} AS text)) != '''' AND r.{{ref_column}} IS NULL', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'AGGREGATE_THRESHOLD', '聚合阈值', 'COMPLETENESS', '检查聚合指标（如空值率）是否超过阈值', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"metric","label":"指标类型","type":"select","required":true,"options":[{"label":"空值率","value":"null_rate"},{"label":"重复率","value":"dup_rate"}]},{"name":"threshold","label":"阈值(百分比)","type":"number","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT 0 AS id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN {{column}} IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) = '''' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS actual_value, ''空值率超过阈值 {{threshold}}%'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN {{column}} IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) = '''' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) > {{threshold}}', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'REGEX_MATCH', '正则匹配', 'ACCURACY', '检查字段值是否匹配指定的正则表达式', '[{"name":"table","label":"目标表","type":"table_select","required":true},{"name":"column","label":"检查列","type":"column_select","required":true},{"name":"pattern","label":"正则表达式","type":"text","required":true}]'::jsonb, 'SELECT id, ''{{column}}'' AS fail_column, {{column}} AS actual_value, ''不匹配正则: {{pattern}}'' AS fail_reason FROM {{table}} WHERE {{column}} IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST({{column}} AS text)) != '''' AND CAST({{column}} AS text) !~ ''{{pattern}}''', true, true, 'system', 'system' );

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO gov_quality_template (code, name, category, description, param_schema, sql_template, builtin, enabled, created_by, last_modified_by) VALUES ( 'CUSTOM_SQL', '自定义SQL', 'COMPLETENESS', '用户自定义SQL查询，需返回 id, fail_column, actual_value, fail_reason 四列', '[{"name":"sql","label":"自定义SQL(需返回id, fail_column, actual_value, fail_reason)","type":"sql_editor","required":true}]'::jsonb, '{{sql}}', true, true, 'system', 'system' );
